title: Acceptance revise accepts dropping a criterion's check binding, but the evaluator then fails that criterion for the removal
outcome: A request to evaluate after a revision that dropped or changed a binding a failing evaluation judged is refused before any evaluator is spawned, naming the criterion, both bindings and the rule; no evaluation is wasted on it.
acceptance: termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses a request before spawning any evaluator when a carried or newest failing evaluation judged a criterion whose binding the current contract drops or changes; the refusal names the criterion, the judged and current bindings, and the rule, no delegation is created and no evaluation is recorded. A test shows it and fails on the unchanged code.

When every judged binding is present and unchanged in the current contract, the request proceeds exactly as before, and the brief's carried-failure sentence (a revision that drops part of the outcome, or a binding, fails that criterion) is unchanged at Full and Compact detail. Tests show it.

The Carried failure paragraph of docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md documents the pre-spawn refusal and states that TermAl's rule is deliberately stricter than Engram's R11 carried-failure rule in docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md.
The full gate passes on the landed input.
The /review-changes pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher finding on the reviewed input.
